templates.name: Cold Outreach to Recruiter
templates.subject: Exploring Opportunities at {company_name}
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I hope this message finds you well. My name is {user_name}, and I'm actively exploring opportunities in the tech industry.

I've been following {company_name}'s work, particularly your recent initiatives in {industry}, and I'm impressed by your company's impact. With my background in software development and my goal of {dream_milestone}, I believe I could contribute meaningfully to your team.

I've attached my resume for your review and would love to schedule a brief call to discuss potential opportunities that align with my skills and your team's needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
{user_name}
templates.editing_tips: Personalize this template by researching the company's recent projects or news. Mention specific technologies or initiatives that align with your skills.

templates.name: Follow-up After Application
templates.subject: Following Up on {job_title} Application
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I wanted to follow up on my application for the {job_title} position at {company_name}, which I submitted on {applied_date}.

I remain very interested in this opportunity and believe my skills in software development would be a great fit for your team. I'm particularly excited about the possibility of contributing to {company_name}'s mission.

If there's any additional information I can provide or if you'd like to schedule a conversation, I'm happy to make myself available at your convenience.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
{user_name}
templates.editing_tips: Send this 7-10 days after applying. Reference specific aspects of the job description that excited you.

templates.name: LinkedIn Connection Request
templates.subject: Connecting - Fellow Tech Professional
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I came across your profile and noticed we share an interest in {industry}. I'm currently on a journey toward {dream_milestone} and would love to connect with professionals like you who are making an impact at {company_name}.

I'd be grateful for the opportunity to learn from your experience and insights in the field.

Looking forward to connecting!

Best,
{user_name}
templates.editing_tips: Keep LinkedIn messages brief. Mention a mutual connection or shared interest if possible.

templates.name: Thank You After Interview
templates.subject: Thank You - {job_title} Interview
templates.body:
Dear {contact_name},

Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today to discuss the {job_title} position at {company_name}. I enjoyed learning more about the team's projects and the company's vision.

Our conversation reinforced my enthusiasm for this opportunity. I'm particularly excited about [specific project or aspect discussed], and I'm confident that my skills and experience would allow me to contribute effectively to your team.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need any additional information from me. I look forward to hearing about the next steps in the process.

Thank you again for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
{user_name}
templates.editing_tips: Send within 24 hours of your interview. Reference specific topics you discussed to show engagement.

templates.name: Request for Informational Interview
templates.subject: Coffee Chat Request - Aspiring {job_title}
templates.body:
Hi {contact_name},

I hope this message finds you well. My name is {user_name}, and I'm working toward {dream_milestone}.

I've been following your career at {company_name} and would love to learn from your experience in {industry}. Would you be open to a brief 20-minute coffee chat (virtual or in-person) where I could ask you a few questions about your journey and seek your advice?

I understand you're busy, so I'm happy to work around your schedule. Thank you for considering my request.

Best regards,
{user_name}
templates.editing_tips: Make it easy for them to say yes by being specific about the time commitment (15-20 minutes). Show genuine interest in their work.
